title: Harden findings-report producer constraints
summary: Findings reports now enforce stricter validation rules for finding IDs, confidence levels, and severity values to prevent contract failures. Finding IDs must not contain citation fragments, uncited findings are restricted to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity, and a checklist clarifies proper handling of citation paths and line numbering.
key_points: Finding IDs must match a pattern rejecting citation paths with hash fragments
Uncited findings limited to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity levels
Knowledge-backed findings retain all existing confidence and severity combinations
Added pre-emission checklist for proper citation ID copying and line number validation
Semantic validation gates remain responsible for source file bounds and exact citation equality
quote: Require every finding ID to match `^[^#]+$`, rejecting citation paths with appended `#location` fragments.
